name: machine
description: llame-machine: the daemon a llame hub starts over SSH to run tools on a remote Machine.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild dist/cli.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' --outfile=dist/llame-machine.cjs && node scripts/build-daemon.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run --coverage --reporter=default --reporter=junit --outputFile.junit=coverage/junit.xml && crap-typescript --threshold 42 --format none src && cargo test --locked --workspace
